description: Use this after search_alterlab to read the full text of one AlterLab page as markdown, so you can follow the documented steps instead of guessing. Pass the url of a search result. Only pages on alterlab.io that search_alterlab can return are readable. Free: needs no API key and never uses credits. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

url.description: An alterlab.io page URL taken from the url field of a search_alterlab result.

name: read_alterlab_page
title: Read AlterLab Page
